{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the number of QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA test orders: {len(qa_rows)}')

# Check the number of refunded orders
refunded_rows = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_rows)}')

# Confirm the number of channels
print(f'Unique channels: {df["channel"].unique()}')"}
